notes.title: Time Tenshi Paradox: Episode 2 - Announcement & Teaser!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're super excited to officially reveal that [b]Time Tenshi Paradox: Episode 2[/b] is in development, and things are progressing really well!

As a special teaser, we've included a preview of a [b]brand new girl[/b] who'll be appearing in this exciting upcoming episode!
What's more, if you can manage to successfully guess her name, we might just reveal a little more detail!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31387289/ae5a9514fd1c2c3a151195741c9311265c4db387.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31387289/aef4a17882ca20ea6a480835b18254743f820e79.jpg[/img][/url]
[i](Click for full size)[/i]

Thanks guys, and we hope you'll look forward to playing in the near future!

- Silver Cow Studio
